item_name: Rothco G.I. Type Alice Keeper Clip-Belt Slides
item_short_desc: Mount pouches and accessories to your belt with ease using Rothco’s G.I. Type Alice Keeper Clip-Belt Slides. These clips are designed to slide onto tactical pouches, ensuring secure attachment to your pistol belt. Constructed from durable metal, these ALICE keepers are built to last, providing reliable use for years. The all-purpose lightweight individual carrying equipment system accessory is ideal for MilSim players, reenactors, outdoorsmen, and more.
